subject.title: Review each selected PR in its own item shard

question: After reviewing exact-head canary evidence, is the protocol-v3 per-item execution model ready to replace the existing sequential shard model?
rationale: This is a broad workflow and durable-queue behavior change whose operational compatibility and rollout acceptance require repository-owner judgment beyond a mechanical repair.

options.title: Require the planned rollout proof
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the exact head has passed the stated isolated and two-item validation, including a claimed mutation publication path.

options.title: Split the migration
options.body: Separate matrix execution from protocol-v3 mutation and generation fencing if maintainers want smaller rollout and rollback boundaries.

options.title: Accept the operational risk
options.body: Approve based on existing checks and partial canary evidence despite the unexercised claimed-mutation boundary.

recommendation.title: Require the planned rollout proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft until the exact head has passed the stated isolated and two-item validation, including a claimed mutation publication path.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies this member as the active contributor for the affected review queue and workflow surfaces; repository leadership should make the final acceptance choice.
